verdict.rationale: Authy has a developer API, so asking for a machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only mentions an SDK for common web languages and the Authy API itself, with no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe also notes the Authy API is closed to new customers and slated for deprecation. Verify API material describes a different successor product and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
